name: c7i-48xl
description: c7i.metal-48xl - custom Intel Sapphire Rapids, dual socket
numa_mode: SNC disabled - 1 NUMA node per socket

confidence.sockets_and_cores: derived from vCPU count and SMT2
confidence.nic_numa_node: ASSUMED node 0. AWS publishes no PCIe root-complex map, and the socket the primary ENA hangs off is a platform wiring choice. Socket 0 is the convention. Settle it with 'lltune nic --live'.

nic_locality: 2 sockets, 1 node each - the NIC is local to one socket, remote to the other
